title: Normalized sections of the open pushforward of an associated affine module
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, and $M$ an $A$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $L=\widetilde M$ on $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], $j:U\to Y$ the inclusion, $\phi:U\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A$ the canonical chart, and $C=j_*\phi^{\mathrm{res}}L$, using open restriction [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] and module pushforward [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists an $A$-linear equivalence $e:M\simeq C(U)$, and $C|_U$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $W=j^{-1}U$ and let $\tau:M\to\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}A,L)$ be the tilde-Gamma unit [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. For every $m\in M$, $e(m)$ equals the inverse chart restriction section isomorphism applied to $\tau(m)|_{\phi(W)}$. This formula includes the zero module and empty affine open.

proof.text: Compose the tilde unit with restriction to the image of the full chart and the inverse restriction section comparison. Each map is additive and bijective: the unit is an isomorphism, the chart image is top, and the section comparison is an isomorphism.

For scalar a, the Spec module action is GammaSpecIso inverse a restricted to the image open. Move this scalar across the restriction comparison. The appIso-hom naturality formula and isoSpec_hom_appTop simplify the ring composite to the open inclusion app on U. Thus the composite is A-linear and defines the required equivalence, with the displayed evaluation formula by construction.

The associated module is quasi-coherent and restriction along the chart isomorphism preserves it. The open-immersion counit identifies restriction of its pushforward with this original chart module, so the restriction of C is quasi-coherent.

theorem exists_selfTor_affine_chart_sections
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)) :
    let L := (tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1)).obj M
    let C := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom).obj L)
    ∃ e : M ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] C.val.obj (op U.1),
      (C.restrict U.1.ι).IsQuasicoherent ∧ ∀ m : M,
        e m = (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.2.isoSpec.hom L
          (U.1.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).inv
          (L.val.map (homOfLE le_top).op ((tilde.adjunction.unit.app M) m))
